crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed…
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I…
God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness...
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man…
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he…
“Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with…
At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne…
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the…
When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men…
Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth…
Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and…
I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

translations.web: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot.
translations.bsb: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
translations.kjv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
translations.asv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, For the salvation of thine anointed; Thou woundest the head out of the house of the wicked man, Laying bare the foundation even unto the neck. Selah.
